goal: Every popular or quick-search card opens an approved semantic page and the homepage never flashes removed content.

intent_model.literal_request: Fix family and birthday links, audit every world, and fix the homepage refresh flash.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Discovery navigation stays canonical and CMS-authoritative across refreshes and future edits.
likely_rejections: A sibling world still uses parameters
A clean page has no results

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory every shared managed discovery source.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: A discovery card identifies a stable page.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Resolve each card to its approved canonical destination.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Click and receive a populated page without stale content.

facts.claim: Event defaults use eventType query parameters.
The homepage client renders fallback data before its API response.

assumptions.claim: The current event catalog has family and birthday matches.

out_of_scope: Transactional searches with dates, guests or active filters

requirements.statement: Family and birthday cards open populated approved pages.
No managed discovery default exposes a parameter URL.
Legacy managed links normalize or are excluded.
Removed homepage content never appears during refresh.

acceptance_checks.observable_result: Clean managed paths and at least one matching result each.

acceptance_checks.setup: All defaults and stale CMS rows
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Known links normalize and unresolved parameter links do not render.

acceptance_checks.setup: Saved presentation with an item removed
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Saved list is used on first paint without a fallback flash.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and tests only; no publication.
